content: {"praised":["Luke Perry delivers strong, engaging acting as Judge Goodnight.","The film captures the spirit of the old west vividly.","Humor and light moments balance drama and action.","Story blends justice themes with personal redemption.","Characters are well-developed and relatable."],"criticized":["Western feels watered-down, TV‑style and mediocre.","Story starts poorly, portraying protagonist as frivolous.”,"  ]}
